title: Bounded native Accordion coverage

covered: Escaped text, ampersand, quotes, newline, and emoji
controls.expected: Edited row remains selectable and renders escaped text as text with a line break; removed/empty public accordion has no accordion wrapper/details; editor exposes Add a question placeholder.
limits: Whitespace-only answers and arbitrary long/malformed text were not separately exercised.

controls.expected: Published row counts and open counts match the selected mode; no page overflow in the captured three-device matrix.
limits: Other named initial-row choices beyond the first row were not recorded.

covered: Enter and Space keyboard activation on Mobile
controls.expected: Enabled mode leaves one details element open after keyboard activation; disabled mode permits multiple open rows; final saved state restored to single=false/open=The first one.
limits: Keyboard proof is Mobile; desktop/tablet keyboard parity was not separately recorded.

controls.expected: Four questions retain four markers for Plus / minus and Caret; None renders zero markers while questions remain.
Empty answer and blank question findings are surfaced; Show me exits preview, selects Accordion in the inspector, and exposes the offending item; incomplete item can be removed.
limits: Only the recorded Site checks paths were exercised; broader validation combinations remain open.

families.expected: Authored Desktop/Tablet/Mobile values are reflected in computed CSS variables and rendered styles; resetting Mobile then Tablet restores inherited Desktop values; zero gap/radius and default current-color values are observed.
limits: The captured reset verifies inherited values, not every arbitrary unit/value.

families.expected: Question computed font weight follows the selected value at all three breakpoints.

style.colorRestore: The default-color receipt observes currentColor/rgb(17,19,17) after reset. It does not prove restoration to an original factory token; do not describe it as factory-token restoration.

finalState.observed: Four authored questions; first and last open in the captured final state; saved default remains single=false/open=The first one.

remainingGaps: Arbitrary values, units, whitespace-only answers, very long content, and malformed input boundaries.
Hover, Focus, Motion, and shared Advanced/visibility/condition controls.
Full responsive save/reload coverage for every content/style combination beyond the recorded matrices.
Additional marker/accessibility semantics and keyboard parity outside the recorded Mobile case.
Production/deployed proof and full customer QA across other modules.
The known candidate85 whole-count typing issue is unrelated to Accordion evidence and is not resolved or reclassified here.
